summary: Very steep narrow lane with homes 9-15 m away.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room to pull off

best_section.where: North side of the steep bend-to-bend link, near the middle of the descent

drivers.seclusion: Trees to the north but houses 9-15 m away at every point; none clear of homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb-to-fence edges; little level ground to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential link between two streets.
drivers.convention: A few cars park near the top; none along the steep part.

flags: Power lines along the south edge
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the north and east on the lower half.
